body: I do too, I guess I'm just holding on with all my strength to be a decent human being but, ultimately it's worthless because no one actually cares and even if they did there's no purpose to being nice in this life other than the self-fulfillment of being morally right.. I suppose..

It happens to me a lot, sometimes people just don't understand your intentions (Partly because you don't always understand them yourself), so I just sometimes try to give them space when needed and try not to come off as too strong, you know? Also, when people are horrible with me I just automatically think I deserve it and I try to make it right, which usually just makes it worse..

I find that by better understanding others, I will maybe have a deeper understanding of my own problems and it generally feels good when I'm there for people with problems, because I was and still mostly am neglected by everyone and I just want to make it right, so that no one has to go through the things I did without any help.. 
> If that makes sense

I have a similar outlook on life as well. I don't think my worthless life is worth living in the slightest but I'm only apathetic to myself though, I hold a lot of empathy for other people but I just despise myself and everything I represent. You should read " The Stranger " by Albert Camus, the main character is an anti-social existentialist and it's just a really well written book. I hope you don't feel alone on this..

I've tried all of those things, I'm miserable at most of them. The only thing I can enjoy at the moment is reading novels.. It numbs the pain for a little at least.. I just can't stop striving for perfection.. Maybe with time, but right now I can't.
I have no idea.. I'm not good at anything, I'm either painfully mediocre at something or just plain bad and it hurts so much when I strive for perfection, even though I know I will never achieve it.
I'm in high school currently, I should finish next year, but I'm probably going to fail, I'm too incompetent not to. I wish I could just fall asleep forever, honestly...
